text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since starting her classic year, Yukino Bijin has been steadily improving.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's it for the ramp sprints? I feel like I gotta couple more sets in me…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh! I don't mean I wanna push myself too hard. It's just, my legs still feel real light!
choice_data_list: That's proof that you're getting stronger!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wowie!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I see! I s'pose that means I've finally gotten used t'my training!
choice_data_list: How about we up the difficulty?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That sounds just dandy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. So I'm improv'n, huh? Now that's someth'n.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: If I keep this up, I bet I'll be able t'do well in the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Triple Tiara is known for having a stacked lineup. Even so, I have growing confidence that she's got what it takes to claim victory in the first race, the Oka Sho.
choice_data_list: (If there's anything that might still be weighing her down, I guess it'd be…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We have the following day off, so I accompany Yukino Bijin to do some shopping at her request.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey! You're the Snow Angel they've been talking about, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! You're even cuter in real life!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Snow Angel? Who's that?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Wait, you don't know?! Your photo has been blowing up on social media! Look!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin and I lean in to look at the social media post the stranger shows us.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Holy cannoli! That's me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like someone snapped a picture of Yukino Bijin's beaming face after the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: They showed this photo on the morning talk show I was watching!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Apparently, the poster just happened to snap a perfect shot. They called it a miraculous shot of a "snow angel," and the name kinda stuck.
choice_data_list: I suppose you do look like a snow angel…
I suppose you do look like a snow angel…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer! Don't you get started on that now!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Ohhh… You even act like an angel… Say, what do you do again? Are you an idol or something?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Nope! I'm a runner.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Oh, okay! Best of luck to you, then! I'll be cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks bunches!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that the girl they showed on the morning news?

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text: For real? You think I could go viral if I manage to nab a selfie with her?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah… roger that!

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Audio
text_block_list.text: "I'm sure you've all seen this photo by now, but here it is again—the picture of the so-called Snow Angel that's been making the rounds online!"

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Audio
text_block_list.text: "Her cuteness has caused the net to absolutely EXPLODE! People are even wondering if she's actually an angel. If you search the term…"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Jeepers! They're really show'n my picture on TV!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She caused a stir online last year too when she declared she was going to take on the Triple Tiara, but that was nothing compared to this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This time, she's being featured on mainstream television, meaning even more people are being exposed to her, hence her explosion in popularity.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I never expected somth'n like this to happen…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But, y'know! A big boost of popularity's a great opp'rtunity for me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I bet a lot more folks'll be com'n to watch m'races now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And I can blow all their socks clean off if I do real well in 'em!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's embarrass'n being called cute and all, but… it does make me happy.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sure would be swell if people started talk'n about how cool I am instead, though!
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll be able to change their minds.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, for sure!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm feel'n pumped now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: If I want you t'keep prais'n my hard work, I better get down to it! Let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I was worried being in the center of attention would bother her, but that doesn't seem to be a problem right now.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Customer A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me… You're the Snow Angel, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Eek! Please don't call me that!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Geez Louise…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You look exhausted, Yukino. I thought you had today off?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, Hishiama! Hello.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Hishi Amazon is my dorm leader. She's real kind and always look'n out for everyone.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I did have today off, but a lotta folks kept com'n up t'talk t'me…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right! I heard you were on TV! That's pretty amazin'!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank you! But, gosh, all the hullabaloo's really got my head spinn'n.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Sounds like you've had it rough. Well, if things get too much to handle, ol' Hishiama is here for you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I haven't made my debut yet, so I probably won't be much help when it comes to races and stuff, but I'll stick with you to the end if anything's ever bugging you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, Hishiama! Thanks oodles!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But my trainer's got my back too, so I'm sure I'll be A-OK!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's good to hear. I know you're plenty strong as well.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You know, I'm actually aiming to make my big debut next year.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wow! Are you really?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's right. And I'm looking forward to racing against you, so keep up the good work!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okey dokey, artichokie!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzt…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow! You passed the badge test? You've been try'n to pass level six for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I know it's real important since you gotta pass in order to enter competitions, but wowie! Pass'n level six is so killer-diller!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Mifuyu!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Thanks! But I still can't enter the world championship till I pass level seven.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: All the other skaters my age have passed that level eons ago… I'm still so far from even the start'n line…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu…

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: But since you're gonna be tak'n on even tougher races now, I can't afford t'stay stuck where I am!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I've actually been doing pretty well since watch'n your race. Even my coach said so!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's great! Things've been going pretty dandy for me too, actually.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's kinda funny, right? Even far apart, we end up going through similar stuff, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh, I'd better skedaddle and go take a bath. We've been talk'n for ages again.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Ah! You're right! It's already dark. The stars over here're awful pretty. How d'they look on your side?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Lemme check…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I can't really see 'em that well, buuut…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I can tell they're still sparkl'n.
